annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology
annotation.summary_en: European Commission landing page for draft guidelines on classifying high-risk AI systems under Article 6 of the AI Act, published 19 May 2026 for stakeholder feedback. Covers Annex I (product safety components needing third-party conformity assessment) and Annex III use cases, with practical examples.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines interpret Article 6 AI Act high-risk classification concepts
Two routes: Annex I product safety components requiring third-party conformity assessment, and Annex III use cases
Includes non-exhaustive practical examples of high-risk and non-high-risk systems per Article 6(5)
Draft released for targeted stakeholder consultation
Split into general principles, Annex I and Annex III sections
annotation.title_clean: Draft Commission guidelines on the classification of high-risk AI systems
annotation.title_en: Draft Commission guidelines on the classification of high-risk AI systems
